note: Practice notes for Run 0 (the prompt playground). Invented. They are NOT part of the scored test set (eval/set-v1) and no scored note may reuse their text. The expected values are a guide for a human reading the output, not an automatic score.

examples.title: Login
examples.text: Sign-in will be magic links only, no passwords. The email service I picked has a free plan with 100 emails a day, which is plenty since I expect about 30 sign-ins daily at launch. Sessions last 30 days.

expected.span: Sign-in will be magic links only, no passwords
has a free plan with 100 emails a day
I expect about 30 sign-ins daily at launch

blindSpots.description: magic links depend on email arriving quickly; delivery delays or spam filtering lock users out
each sign-in costs one email, so the daily cap is also a sign-in cap

examples.title: Pilot with first client
examples.text: ok so Brightmolar Clinic (Ines runs it) agreed to pilot for €250/mo. need SMS reminders - assume twilio or whatever is like 1 cent per text?? 3 reminders per appointment, ~600 appts a month. host on the cheapest VPS, I can move later if it gets slow

expected.span: assume twilio or whatever is like 1 cent per text
I can move later if it gets slow

blindSpots.description: SMS price per message varies by country and is often several cents; 1,800 messages a month may take a large share of the fee
appointment reminders for a clinic are health-related personal data

examples.title: Name and look
examples.text: Name ideas: Slotwise, Bookbird, Remindly. Kind of like the bird one. Could do a mascot. Colours - teal? Something calm. Think about a landing page vibe later.
